meta.title: Text Encoding Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert text between plain text, hex, binary, octal, decimal, Base64, URL, HTML entities, Unicode, ASCII, ROT13, and Morse code.
steps_text-encoder_1Desc: Type or paste text into the input area. The encoder supports multiple encoding formats for different use cases and programming needs.
steps_text-encoder_2Desc: Select the encoding — URL encode/decode, HTML entities, Base64, Unicode escape sequences, or binary. View encoded and decoded results side by side.
steps_text-encoder_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the encoded or decoded result. Perfect for web development, API parameter encoding, and data transformation tasks.
